deck: CONTROL THE SITE. VERIFY THE POWER.
site_ui.lead: Secure conditional control of promising data-center and battery-storage sites before committing capital to unverified power stories.
site_ui.summary: Site-option economics depend on option premiums, extension payments, diligence burn, assignment rights, and the probability of securing a buyer before expiry; nearby transmission or a substation does not establish available capacity. Distinct revenue lanes include negotiated option assignments, development-stage site sales, and permitted siting or development services, with data-center load service and BESS interconnection underwritten separately.
chapters: Q12: Scale a Stage-Gated Site Portfolio
flow: Screen parcels for utility territory, network proximity, zoning, access, fiber, and environmental constraints.
Seek utility-backed load-service or interconnection information; treat mapped headroom as an unconfirmed signal.
Negotiate counsel-reviewed options with diligence access, milestones, and explicit assignment provisions.
Evaluate title, engineering, permitting, utility costs, and project-specific operating constraints.
Present a source-documented package to qualified buyers without describing speculative capacity as secured.
Close an authorized assignment or development transaction, or terminate before additional carry destroys the margin.
